title: The Companies (Revision of Defective Accounts and Reports) Regulations 2008
quote: The directors of the company must, within 28 days of the date of revision, deliver to the registrar— (a) in the case of a revision by replacement, a copy of the revised accounts or (as the case may be) the revised report, together with a copy of the auditor's report on those accounts or (as the case may be) on that report, or (b) in the case of a revision by supplementary note, a copy of that note, together with a copy of the auditor's report on the revised accounts or (as the case may be) on the revised report.
